name: Cambay commercial lobby
goals: Keep space for Cambay consignments before the return sailing.
Press the court over Portuguese access without committing every captain to the same bargain.
bio: The Cambay shahbandar brings complaints about competition to court. Merchants who depend on his introductions still make their own decisions about whether to trade.
notes: fact: Araújo’s report associates the Gujarati shahbandar with opposition to Portuguese entry; Pires later records Gujaratis returning to trade (Birch III, p. 70; Pires II, pp. 254–258, 283)
gameplay: The roster merchants are fictional constituents, not attested subscribers to the lobby or a formal guild (people-factions.md §§3–4; data/merchants)
